summary: The app version and build number are visible both on the signed-out login card and in profile settings. The constants are checked against the package release version, currently 1.0.13+18.

checks.name: Test-first login version indicator
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/auth_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'shows the app version before login'
checks.observation: The test first failed because the login card had no version label. The version 1.0.13 (18) is now visible before authentication.

checks.name: Profile version and package synchronization
checks.observation: Profile settings render the same version/build label, and a source test asserts the constants match the version declared by pubspec.yaml.

checks.name: Complete Flutter tests and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub --no-fatal-infos
checks.observation: All 281 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

remaining: Signed ABI-split APK publication and physical-device confirmation are tracked separately as the Android release result.
